data.title: Apple and Meta team up to make Muse AI model run on Mac computers
data.description: Apple and Meta are collaborating to make Muse Spark Open easier to run locally on clustered Mac Studio systems, according to the companies.
data.author: Kif Leswing,Jonathan Vanian
